key_findings: On the exact frozen post frame (same bytes, SHA 4cb8a6b4…), Vision reads the photo-count line as 57張照片 with confidence 1.00 at px[12,120,66,136] - inside the neighbourhood of the frozen count_box [9,109,177,139] where the frozen tesseract reader read 75. Strong supplementary evidence that the navigation reached the target album showing 57 photos, and that the frozen TARGET_MISMATCH came from reader variance on tiny glyphs.

The frozen probe crops show the same phenomenon: the frozen locator read 27 (scale 1) and 5 (scale 2) while Vision read 57 at confidence 1.00 in both sizes. Two independent frozen readings failed the same glyphs that Vision read consistently.
Album-card identity is consistent across pre/post: pre frame card title 2024/05/13~05/17 with 57 below it; post frame header title 2024/05/13~05/17 with 57張照片 below it.

Resolution effect (relevant to owner questions about image compression/size): on the 1x pre frame Vision misread the group name as 旻議允禎成長日記 (conf 0.50, 謙→議) but read 旻謙允禎成長日記 correctly at 2x (conf 1.00); the count digits 57 read at confidence 1.00 at both 1x and 2x. For this failure, engine choice mattered more than upscaling, while upscaling helped the harder glyphs.
Frozen verdict unchanged: this artifact is supplementary and non-authoritative; it does NOT grant ALBUM_OPEN_VERIFIED and does not reopen attempt-05.
limitations: Produced outside the frozen toolchain; cannot flip any frozen gate by itself.
Vision line bboxes are per-line text boxes, not the frozen tool's scale-1 count-box geometry; coordinates are not directly interchangeable with frozen outputs.
The raw stdout files live in /tmp and are not committed; the SHA-256 values here bind the exact bytes, and every reading is transcribed verbatim as a raw_line.
No new UI input was sent; this does not re-run the route step and no capture was taken.

Toolchain decision: whether to adopt the macOS-native Vision OCR as an official reading aid. If yes, open a new plan revision + independent review + fresh authorization before touching the frozen toolchain.
